meta.topic: How Often You Should Get Paid (And Why It Matters More Than You Think)

style_notes: Dark moody background (#0A1020 to #0F172A), green accent (#22C55E), clean bold typography. 'SAME SALARY' is the dominant visual — large, green, impossible to miss. Creates curiosity gap.
hook_source: Same salary but different pay frequency creates completely different financial outcomes — and most people never think about it
revised_hook: You and your coworker earn the exact same salary. But he gets paid $2,500 twice a month, and you get paid $2,307 every two weeks. Same money. Different rhythm. And that difference is why one of you is stressed about bills.
